column2: Sin is being turned away, after knowledge, from the work of one's own hand; its contrary is the facing of that same work under the same knowledge. Repentance, which comes after sin, is that contrary only insofar as it arrives at the facing, and grace is the facing when it is given rather than achieved.
Sin is the turning away, after knowledge, from the work of one's own hand; its opposite is the facing. Repentance is the road back to that facing, and grace is the facing given.
